title: pip certificate path configured but empty
description: pip.conf declares an empty `cert` setting. The client falls back to whatever trust store the runtime carries, so the accepted index certificates are unspecified.
remediation: Point `cert` at the real bundle, or remove the setting deliberately.
limitation: It matches an empty `cert` setting in the parsed pip.conf; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
